SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_users) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tb_user_roles WHERE role = 'INSTRUCTOR') AS instructor_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_institutions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS institution_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS course_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS course_in_progress_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'RECRUITING') AS course_recruiting_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'COMPLETED') AS course_completed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollments) AS enrollment_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tb_user_roles WHERE role = 'LEARNER') AS learner_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tb_user_roles WHERE role = 'INSTITUTION_ADMIN') AS institution_admin_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_users WHERE status = 'WITHDRAWN') AS withdrawn_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_instructor_applications WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS instructor_application_pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_institution_applications WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS institution_application_pending, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) FROM tb_user_roles r JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.role = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE') AS instructor_active_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) FROM tb_user_roles r JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.role = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND u.status IN ('DORMANT', 'SUSPENDED')) AS instructor_inactive_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) FROM tb_user_roles r JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.role = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND u.status = 'WITHDRAWN') AS instructor_withdrawn_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_users WHERE created_at >= CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) - INTERVAL '30 days') AS recent_signup_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_institutions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE') AS institution_active_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_institutions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'ACTIVE') AS institution_inactive_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_completions WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completion_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_learning_badges WHERE status = 'ISSUED') AS badge_count

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, COALESCE( (SELECT r.role FROM tb_user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = u.id ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT 1), 'LEARNER') AS role, u.created_at FROM tb_users u ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) FROM tb_user_roles r WHERE r.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND r.role = 'INSTRUCTOR') AS instructor_total, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) FROM tb_user_roles r JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND r.role = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE') AS instructor_active, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) FROM tb_user_roles r JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND r.role = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND u.status IN ('DORMANT', 'SUSPENDED')) AS instructor_inactive, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) FROM tb_user_roles r JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND r.role = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND u.status = 'WITHDRAWN') AS instructor_withdrawn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses c WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS course_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollments e JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId}) AS enrollment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses c WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'RECRUITING') AS course_recruiting, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses c WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS course_in_progress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_courses c WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'COMPLETED') AS course_completed,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollments e JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_enrollment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_completions cp JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completion_count

SELECT COALESCE(r.name, '미분류') AS category, COUNT(*) AS course_count FROM tb_courses c LEFT JOIN tb_course_classifications r ON r.code = SUBSTRING(c.classification_code FROM 1 FOR 7) || '0000' WHERE c.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(r.name, '미분류') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, COALESCE(r.name, '미분류') ASC
